By The Sea by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 By The Sea is a new, 3-bedroom home in the Highland Park community, in laid-back Blue Mountain Beach. The neighborhood has a resort-style, tropically landscaped lagoon pool, which includes a hot tub, 360-observation tower, community grilling area, and firepit with comfy chairs and couches. Inside, the open living and dining area is huge and wonderfully decorated. Off the primary bedroom, king, a private balcony lets you enjoy your morning coffee as you take in the sunrise and views of Point Washington State Forest. A second and third guest room, both queen, is nearby, with a queen sleeper in the living room. A golf cart and 3 bikes are complimentary, so take advantage of biking or hiking Point Washington State Forest, or visit the nearby shops and restaurants. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 1.1 miles to the beach (Blue Mountain Beach Regional Access) - Backs up to resort pool and cabana - 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath - 2010 sq ft - Outdoor shower - Wi-Fi - Natural gas grill - 3 bikes included - Complimentary golf cart (Only 1 golf cart per property per strict HOA rules, please do not rent a second cart.) Overnight: - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV (42") - Queen in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath; TV (42") - Queen in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath; TV (42") - Queen sleeper sofa in the living room Check-in is 4:00 PM CST.

Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
